class.name: OcgPrs3dArrow
class.brief_description: Provides class methods to draw an arrow at a given location, along a given direction and using a given angle.
class.description: ! Provides class methods to draw an arrow at a given location, along a given direction and using a ! given angle.

method.name: DrawShaded
method.description: Defines the representation of the arrow as shaded triangulation.

method.name: DrawSegments
method.description: Defines the representation of the arrow as a container of segments.

method.name: Draw
method.description: Defines the representation of the arrow. Note that this method does NOT assign any presentation aspects to the primitives group!
